prompt_md: Four teams play a round robin: each pair meets once, and every game is a coin flip with no ties. What's the chance some team wins all three of its games?
prompt_short: 4-team round robin of coin flips. Chance some team goes 3-0?
hint_md: Can two teams both win all their games?
explain_intuition_md: Each team goes 3-0 with chance 1 in 8, and treating the four teams as independent gives about 41%. But two teams can never both go unbeaten, since they play each other. The four cases never overlap, so you can simply add them up.
